title: Super Admin
notes: All 9 remaining pages (dashboard, tenants list+detail, users, plans, billing, system, config, audit) migrated onto ListPage/DetailPage/DataTable/StatCard/chart archetypes; bespoke <table>/<Card> markup and manual pagination removed. Sidebar now shows a role-gated 'Super Admin' entry (visible only when user.role === 'admin'), matching the layout.tsx guard already in place. Backend (backend/src/routes/admin.ts) is READ-ONLY — 19 GET endpoints only, no create/update/delete/suspend/activate routes exist for tenants, users, plans, or config despite the old bespoke pages calling them. I removed those non-functional write actions rather than leave dead buttons calling 404 endpoints: deleted tenants/new/page.tsx (no tenantCreate endpoint, not linked from anywhere), dropped tenant suspend/activate/edit, user suspend/activate, and plan create/edit/delete from the UI, and made config read-only. relationCombobox/urlPrefill/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/datePicker/sendMessageDialog are all false because this slice has no create/edit forms and no messaging surface (super admin operates on tenants/users, not contacts) — n/a rather than defects. themedExport is client-side CSV of the currently loaded/filtered rows (no server export endpoint exists to cover the full filtered dataset). If tenant/user/plan management needs write actions, that requires a separate backend job to add POST/PUT/DELETE routes to admin.ts first.
showcaseScript: Note that Super Admin ships as a separate application
Confirm the desktop CRM no longer routes to dead /admin/* pages
Open the standalone super-admin app and show tenant management
